scope: Same actual native-count-v2 measured P04, frozen deterministic policies; 512 pitch[-10,-5]deg standing resets per seed, full 8s mature head5 reward stack for both arms; no injected pushes, no policy input truth substitution
limitations: Whole requested negative-pitch bucket diagnostic on fixed development seeds, not complete +/-10deg, all-recovery, final held-out or hardware qualification. Before/after are frozen checkpoints from the same lineage; this evaluation is used for ongoing model selection.
gate_scope: Each seed >=95% no-fall and >=99% final-stable with zero faults on current frontier; full-range recovery and other standing bins must also be retained before a manual curriculum change
